notes.content:

notes.title: Flood Update v0.18.0
notes.content:
[h1]Version 0.18.0[/h1]

[list]
[*] Updated translations.
[*] Fixed a bug where clients had the island forcefield in creative mode.
[*] Updated flood water behavior.
[/list]

notes.title: Flood Update v0.17.0
notes.content:
[h1]Version 0.17.0[/h1]

[list]
[*] Adds button to vote for end of build phase to all game modes
[*] Fixes bug that the end of round alarm sound only sounds in the first round
[*] Fixes bug when selecting a new player to spectate
[/list]

notes.title: Flood Update v0.16.0
notes.content:
[h1]Version 0.16.0[/h1]

[list]
[*] Added translations for Steam inventory items
[*] Added sound indicator for enemy boat damage
[*] Added 5 new boat parts
[*] Fixed Bonk Stick animation getting stuck
[*] Updated Leafblower sound effects
[/list]

notes.title: Flood Update v0.15.0
notes.content:
[h1]Version 0.15.0[/h1]

[list]
[*] Introduced the ability to join a lobby using an invite code.
[*] Added turntable for character preview in the inventory.
[*] Implemented new item notifications on the main menu.
[*] Displayed item rarity directly in the inventory list.
[/list]

notes.title: Flood Update v0.12.0
notes.content:
[h1]Version 0.12.0[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixes incorrectly saved music settings
[*] Fixes some bugs in creative mode
[*] Fixes hitbox error with Bonk Stick
[*] Fixes a bug that freezes spectators after the end of a round

[/list]

notes.content:

[list]
[*] Bug Fix: Fixes Player Boundary size sync

[*] Bug Fix: Minor bugfix regarding the inventory list update after item drop
